sermons.title: Understanding the Kingdom of God
summary: The kingdom of God is the government of God expressed on earth.
Every believer is a carrier of kingdom culture, principles, and power.
Seeking the kingdom first re-orders every other priority.

sermons.title: The Currency of Prayer
summary: Prayer is the primary means by which spiritual authority is administered.
Consistent prayer builds spiritual capacity and sensitivity to the Spirit.
Kingdom-minded prayer prioritises God's will over personal comfort.

sermons.title: Discovering Your Assignment
summary: Every person has a divine assignment attached to their existence.
Purpose is discovered in the presence of God, not in trend chasing.
Alignment with purpose brings peace, provision, and unusual grace.
